Currently, to prove termination of a while-loop with mvcgen one needs to provide a docs#Std.Do.WhileVariant which amounts to a Nat:

def WhileVariant (α : Type u) (ps : PostShape.{u}) :=
  α → SVal ps.args (ULift Nat)

Does this inherently have to be a Nat, or could it be any type with a docs#WellFoundedRelation ?

I'm asking as I'm trying to prove termination of a while-loop which follows easily when considering a lexicographically ordered pair of Nats. However, constructing an order-preserving embedding of such a pair into Nat makes the termination proof much harder in my case (and is not even possible in general).

cc @Sebastian Graf

Exactly, I'm working on lifting that requirement. Unfortunately, it comes at the cost of inserting .ofMeasure in the specification of your variants, but I think that is an acceptable cost.

Note that I won't fix this for mvcgen, I'm afraid. However, a vcgen release isn't too far away at this point. Mostly need to upstream Std.Internal to their proper place and write documentation.

Sebastian Graf said in #general > mvcgen: WhileVariant:

it comes at the cost of inserting .ofMeasure in the specification of your variants, but I think that is an acceptable cost

Very acceptable indeed :D
